changedMechanism: Reset only the existing slot to zero after a completed text-close opcode2. Use the compact field parent. No raw semantic-state reconstruction or new slot recognition.

controls.definition: Compute the identical text-close predicate but leave slot unchanged. P/K archives, probabilities and parent projection must agree.
Apply only slot=0 after complete opcode2. Every arm independently inverts, repeats and synchronizes all predictive state.

hypothesis.claim: Resetting stale slot state at decoded text-close boundaries reduces the complete opening250KB archive relative to the unchanged compact parent and unused-reset control.
hypothesis.falsification: No strict complete archive saving rejects this reset-only realization on development; inactive state, implementation failure and resource stops remain distinct.

invariants: Do not mutate sealed parent source or use retained probability files as decoder inputs. All byte histories and existing field/mixer/coder/copy laws stay unchanged.

Use the pre-update opcode-pending flag to recognize a complete opcode2, then reset slot after the normal byte update. Escaped literal zero followed by literal byte2 is not a reset. Every copied modeled byte follows the same path.
P and K authoritative projection/probabilities/payload must agree. Every arm independently inverts and repeats. D observed and unobserved output must agree.

Observe text-close counts, effective resets, post-update slot occupancy, literal/copy coverage and full probability/update/arithmetic/state witnesses; these are not per-slot predictive loss attribution.
Synthetic tests use CPU3, one thread, 2GiB address space, 240 CPU seconds, 300 elapsed seconds and 64MiB scratch. No corpus run before source/ownership publication and fresh CPU2 admission.

Opening250KB gate uses CPU2, one thread, 4GiB aggregate memory, zero swap, 1GiB scratch, 2400 elapsed seconds. Each phase is bounded to 2GiB address space, 180 CPU seconds and 240 elapsed seconds. Basis: compact opening observed encode53.16 seconds and decode27.92 seconds, with independent arms and bookkeeping overhead.
